description: Earth's plate count, plate areas and speeds for the plate measures of terrain roadmap T8 (scripts/uwtools/plate_metrics.py --earth, which asserts that the areas sum to 4 pi sr within 1e-4). Areas from PB2002, speeds in the no-net-rotation frame of NNR-MORVEL56.
status: verified 2026-10-18 against both sources (Bird 2003 Table 1; the NNR-MORVEL56 angular-velocity table); the 52 areas sum to 12.56638 sr (4 pi = 12.56637).

sources.citation: Bird, P. (2003), An updated digital model of plate boundaries, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 4(3), 1027, doi:10.1029/2001GC000252
sources.used_for: plate count (52) and plate areas (Table 1, steradians)

sources.citation: Argus, D. F., Gordon, R. G., and DeMets, C. (2011), Geologically current motion of 56 plates relative to the no-net-rotation reference frame, Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems 12, Q11001, doi:10.1029/2011GC003751
sources.used_for: plate count (56) and per-plate RMS speeds in the no-net-rotation frame (the table's Rms column)

summary.speed_method: sqrt(sum A_i rms_i^2 / sum A_i) over the 56 NNR-MORVEL56 plates, rms_i the table's per-plate Rms column, A_i the plate areas; the table does not state that its per-plate Rms is area-averaged
